_meta.name: OwnPulse Design Tokens
_meta.description: Canonical, versioned source of truth for OwnPulse design tokens. Migrated verbatim from web/src/styles/variables.css. The chart.metric color slots feed the downstream Style Dictionary pipeline and chart-color unit (B5).
_meta.chartMetricColors: Per-metric chart color slots under chart.metric. heart_rate, hrv, and weight reuse exact values from the existing palette (web/src/styles/variables.css), and the fallback cycle reuses web/src/components/explore/chartColors.ts (lowercased). sleep_duration, glucose, bp_systolic, and bp_diastolic are newly assigned from existing palette colors and the colorblind-safe Wong palette to give each metric a distinct, accessible hue. bp_systolic deliberately avoids the brand-primary hue (#c2654a) so chart series do not collide with brand-colored UI chrome.

energy.$description: Check-in dimension color for Energy. Diverges from color.dimension.gold (#c49a3c) — the raw gold value clears only ~2.5:1 against the light surfaces, below the 3:1 WCAG AA graphical-object floor the ScoreRing ring/arc and SparklineRow line need. Darkened along the same hue to ~3.4:1 (surface.bg) / ~3.5:1 (surface.elevated); re-verify with tools/design-tokens/contrast.js if this value ever changes.

mood.$description: Check-in dimension color for Mood. Mirrors color.primary.default — a literal duplicate (not a DTCG alias; build.js reads original token values directly).

body.value: "IBM Plex Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

intervention.$description: Marker color for intervention (substance/medication/supplement) events overlaid on charts. Brand purple, replacing the off-palette flat-UI #9b59b6. Intervention markers are shape-distinct from series lines, so the hue overlap with color.dimension.libido is acceptable.
